accepted.label: Zero Frequency Error and Laplace Smoothing Concept
accepted.description: Understanding that zero frequency error occurs when a feature value is unseen in training, and that Laplace smoothing adds a small constant to counts to prevent zero probabilities, with the parameter α controlling the smoothing strength.
coverage_criteria: Explain how Laplace smoothing mitigates the error.
Describe the effect of the smoothing parameter α.
accepted.merge_rationale: Standalone definitional concept; the implementation candidate (lr005_015) adds practical application which is a deepening and is kept separate.

accepted.label: Applying Laplace Smoothing in Naive Bayes
accepted.description: Ability to apply Laplace smoothing to word count tables using the formula (count + 1) / (total words + vocabulary size) to avoid zero probabilities for unseen words.
coverage_criteria: Apply Laplace smoothing to word count tables.
accepted.merge_rationale: Standalone implementation concept; the definitional candidate (lr005_005) covers the foundational understanding but not the hands-on formula application.
